exposure: Maternal characteristics (age, education level, parity, pre-pregnancy weight, diabetes, smoking, weight gain during pregnancy)
cohort: 6087 infants from the general population who tested positive for HLA DR3-DQ2 or DR4-DQ8
finding: Cesarean section was not associated with an increased risk for CDA or CD in the offspring after adjusting for confounding factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was not associated with an increased risk for CDA or CD in the offspring.
